vulnerability.name: Hadoop YARN ResourceManager Unauthenticated Command Execution
vulnerability.author: Sofia Markusfeld
Tom Shaw
vulnerability.description: Stands up a single-node Hadoop (pseudo-distributed) YARN ResourceManager in its default, unauthenticated configuration. Hadoop's standard ResourceManager REST API accepts unauthenticated application submissions, which can be used to execute arbitrary commands on the cluster.
vulnerability.hint: The YARN ResourceManager web UI/REST API is open with no authentication.
vulnerability.solution: Submit a crafted application via the unauthenticated ResourceManager REST API (new-application -> submit-application) to run an arbitrary command as the hadoop service account.
